text:
Priya N: FYI customer reported duplicate webhook deliveries when our SDK retried streaming requests after a 429 spike.
Sam G: can you share short repro?
Priya N: simple: stream sends chunk A (server calls external webhook), connection drops, SDK retries whole POST -> webhook sees chunk A again.
Tao H: is this Node-only?
Priya N: Node and Go clients default to auto-retry. Python had a safe_replay flag but only for non-streams.
CI-Bot: test failure: examples/streaming-idempotency/flaky_test failing on main #4899
Ivy L: immediate thoughts: 1) default to NOT retrying streaming requests; 2) prefer resume-token semantics when server supports it; 3) if user opts into unsafe retries, require strong randomized jitter.
Sam G: agree. We should add a small in-process replay-guard cache that remembers first-chunk event ids for ~30s to avoid immediate duplicate back-to-back replays when server lacks resume support. Not perfect, but it reduces blast radius.
Tao H: design of resume: server returns `x-rw-resume-token` on first flush and `x-rw-resume-window` TTL. Client attaches `x-rw-resume-token` when retrying. Server rejects duplicates based on token and window.
Ivy L: privacy note: any local fingerprint must be salted and ephemeral (no disk). Do not log prompt text.
Priya N: logging and telemetry plan: emit `sdk.streaming.replay_blocked` with non-identifying fingerprint and `sdk.streaming.resume_seen`.
Sam G: backoff details for unsafe mode: use full jitter with base=200ms, cap=8s. Also add max_attempts=5 for streaming unsafe retries.
Tao H: SDK parity: Node and Go default to safe (no auto-retry). Python will flip default later but provide compatibility flag.
CI-Bot: opened issue #6039: streaming-replay-guard and linked failing test.
Priya N: I'll add sample app `examples/streaming-replay-guard` demonstrating three modes: NO_RETRY, RESUME_TOKEN, UNSAFE_RETRY. Include small harness that simulates drop-after=N and counts webhook calls.
Ivy L: docs: update retry section to explicitly state idempotency_key does not make streaming safe; show header examples.
Sam G: I'll PR changes to core backoff util so all languages use same jitter algorithm.
Tao H: server RFC queued to define token format and verification window.
Priya N: action items: Sam implement guard + backoff changes, Tao draft server RFC, Ivy update docs, I'll commit sample and test vectors.
Sam G: noted. will also add CI e2e that toggles guard and asserts webhook count.
Priya N: thanks all. short term mitigation: publish patch that disables auto-retry for streaming in next minor release.
Ivy L: thumbs up. end thread.
